Don-Jo PP-16x26-628, 16 x 26 Brushed Aluminum Kickplate

The 16 x 26 Aluminum plate is made of .050 inch thick aluminum. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation. This Aluminum 8 inch x 34 inch plate is primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores.

Specifications of the 16 x 26 Aluminum Plate:

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Brushed Aluminum with Clear Anodizing
  • Plate Length: 26"
  • Plate Width: 16"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

Sold Individually

Custom item, NOT Returnable
